summary.headline: Florentine Codex Astrological Questions
summary.text: Catalog entries for Florentine codex folios 34–49, covering questions about the inquirer, phlebotomy, thought, the cause and subject of questions, stars and their forms, brothers, decans, synodic degrees with the Sun, wealth, debt, landed property, tenants, and estates. Authorities named are Dorotheus, Apomasar, and Mashallah.
